description: NaviJSON California enrichment regions. `statewide` is the full-state bounding box used for large tiled runs (do not commit its raw output); `committed` regions are small, representative extracts generated and checked in as the demonstration Reality Layer.

statewide.name: State of California
statewide.note: Whole-state extent. Generate via a downloaded Geofabrik California PBF + tippecanoe rather than a live Overpass call. See docs/A_M_LIGHT.md.

committed.name: I-280 / CA-87 Interchange, San José
committed.note: Freeway interchange chosen to exercise bridge/tunnel/layer grade separation (overpasses and underpasses).
